Matched m128, m107, m95, m78, m125, m206, m141, m211 and m119 rows test amount and endpoint interactions. Intermediate solvent points for m59, m82, m106, m159, m178, m204, m212, m173 and m45 discriminate gradual curves from thresholds or turnovers. Amino, pyridyl, quinoline-like and nitrile-containing selections address nitrogen-specific and high-retention failures. Carbonyl, polycarbonyl, acid and OH rows provide structural transfer across recurring catalog motifs. The mixture should improve generalization by teaching both where the current predictor systematically misses late finishes and where observed unusual intervals should remain local rather than become global corrections."}
